search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search names and text in files
search.textNote: Text search finds files only. It reads plain text and the documents the server can turn into text.
search.label: Label
search.label.hint.text: Matches the start of the value. Upper and lower case are different.
search.label.hint.number: A number, or a range such as 5..10.
search.label.hint.date: A date such as 2026-01-31, or a range such as 2026-01-01..2026-01-31.
search.label.restricted: A restricted label matches only for the managers of a file.
search.labelsOff: Label filters are not available right now.
search.prompt: Type a word, or choose a filter.
search.needWords: A text search needs a word to look for.
search.empty: Nothing matches these words and filters. Try other words, or take a filter away.
search.pageEmpty: Nothing on this part of the results matched. More results may follow.
search.snippetNote: The text is shown in lower case, as it is indexed.
search.err.tooLong: The search is too long. Use shorter words.
search.err.words: Each word needs at least two letters or digits.
search.err.labelValue: Check the value for this label.
search.err.invalid: The server did not accept this search. Change the words or the filters.
search.err.rateLimited: Too many searches. Wait a minute, then try again.
search.err.slow: The search took too long. Try narrower words or filters.
search.err.off: Search is turned off on this server.
